The viewed steps[7] image labels 3 21/32" between slides and 2 27/64" between the 3"-tall boxes (cutList[3] sides 3" wide): box pitch 3 + 2.422 = 5.42", which matches the fronts. The 3 21/32" figure is a gap, not a bottom-to-bottom pitch.
